name: 雪绒鸟
evolution: 雪绒鸟 → 冬羽雀 Lv.5 → 岚鸟 Lv.30 → 霜翼领主
evolutionEn: Xuerongniao → Dongyuque Lv.5 → Lanniao Lv.30 → Shuangyilingzhu
description: 冬天诞生的小鸟精灵，常把身体缩成球状减少散热。喜欢用幼嫩的喙啄刚落地的新雪，既是食用也是玩耍。
descriptionEn: A small bird spirit born in winter; it often curls its body into a ball to reduce heat loss. It likes to peck at freshly fallen snow with its young beak, both as food and as play.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if it attacks before the enemy, this skill's power +50%.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +20 power to all skills and Swift.

skills.name: 闪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，速度比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher its Speed compared to the enemy, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 风起
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains 1 stack of Rising Wind mark.

skills.name: 俯冲猛击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Speed +80; against Defense: Speed +160 instead.

skills.name: 羽刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：回合结束使敌方紧急脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; against Status: at the end of the turn, forces the enemy to retreat urgently.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, Swift; against Status: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.
